create.name: Dina Ghandour
create.bio:
Dina Ghandour is a Jivamukti yoga teacher and meditation guide who lives and teaches in Dubai. She first met yoga as a teenager through a video bought for home practice, and kept returning to it through the turns of a career in public relations and marketing and the yoga clothing label she set up in the city in 2013. She has taught since 2015 and holds the Jivamukti 300-hour certification, alongside training as a Usui Reiki Master.

Her weekly classes in Dubai follow the Jivamukti method, so a strong vinyasa sequence sits next to chanting, scripture, intention and a closing meditation. Her meditation teaching is secular and approachable: short guided sessions, body scans and themed series, many of them offered online or recorded for later. She also leads small retreats in the UAE mountains and abroad, co-teaches longer immersions for yoga teachers, and has written a reflective journal that asks teachers to work from felt experience rather than performance. Much of her recent work turns on rest, embodiment and community care, and on letting the practice slow down rather than add to the pace of life.

courses.title: Moving Fields: An Andalucía Retreat
courses.description: A week in a villa in the hills of Málaga, led with Lina Nahhas, for people who spend their lives looking after others. The days mix yoga, 5Rhythms dance, family constellation work, ritual, storytelling and time outdoors.
courses.price: €2,800 EUR shared, €3,300 EUR single (regular rate; earlier booking rates published)

courses.title: Yoga for the Embodied Teacher (108-Hour Training, Dubai)
courses.description: An in-person training for yoga teachers and committed students, co-led with Alice Gray at Heal Hub in Umm Suqeim. Three four-day modules cover embodiment, anatomy, teaching method, philosophy and critical questioning of inherited habits; modules can also be booked singly.
courses.price: AED 12,500 (standard rate, all three modules; community and supporter rates and single modules also published)

courses.title: 10-Day Meditation Series
courses.description: Ten recorded guided meditations of about twenty minutes, one a day, each with its own theme and technique. Suited to beginners, with three months of access.

courses.title: Remembering the Body: A Journal for Yoga Teachers
courses.description: A short downloadable journal of prompts and reflections for yoga teachers. It invites them to look again at habits picked up in training and to teach from what they sense in their own bodies.

courses.title: Jivamukti Yoga Classes in Dubai
courses.description: Weekly group classes at Zoga in Dubai Internet City, including a midweek vinyasa flow and a longer Sunday sadhana. Classes follow the Jivamukti method, weaving chanting, philosophy and meditation into the physical practice.

courses.title: Virtual Group and Private Classes
courses.description: Online sessions booked through her site: 75-minute Jivamukti classes, half-hour meditations and one-to-one lessons.

free_resources.title: 7-Day Chakra Meditation Series
free_resources.description: Seven short recorded meditations, about five minutes each, moving from the root to the crown. Each one can be downloaded and used day by day.

free_resources.title: Embracing Uncertainty Meditation
free_resources.description: A ten-minute guided sit about meeting change and not knowing with steadiness and trust. It is one of several free recordings on her Listen page.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @wellnesswithdina 60 subscribers (channel header, 4 Nov 2026); Instagram and Facebook @wellnesswithdina not readable without logging in (not opened) → ~60 readable → local_hero
flags: Email is support@dinaghandour.com, published as the mailto email icon in the site's social bar (every page, including /contact); it is a support-style inbox. A gmail address also appears but only in hidden page data, so it was not used.

She also offers womb and fertility massage, Thai massage, birth doula work and 'closing the bones' postpartum ritual; these are bodywork/health-framed and were left out. Her main published work is Jivamukti yoga, meditation and retreats, so I judged her not mainly health-led; a human may want to check.

Her YouTube channel includes two 11-hour 'Reading of the Names' videos (a Gaza names vigil, watermelon emoji) and talks titled 'Decolonising Yoga + The Body' and 'The Body as Territory + Memory'. Not partisan commentary in my reading, and none were picked, but worth a look under the political-content rule.
Her site's Listen page and resource library include an 'anxiety' meditation and articles on the vagus nerve and health benefits of massage; none were picked.
Instagram and Facebook URLs appear on her site but weren't opened (logins), so left null.
Found via a web search for Kundalini/meditation teachers in Dubai (her squarespace page came up).

'Yoga for the Embodied Teacher' dates (modules 7-10 Jan, 11-14 Feb, 18-21 Mar 2027) and prices come from co-teacher Alice Gray's page https://www.alicegray.yoga/embodied-teacher (robots.txt checked, open); the item links to Dina's own page for it. Alice's page calls Dina 'a Palestinian healer and guide' focused on women's health; not used.
left_out: Womb Therapy + Thai Massage, Birth Doula, Closing the Bones (health/body-treatment framed; fertility named).
Reiki Energy Healing sessions and Reiki gift voucher (page promises sleep and physical balance benefits; health claim).
Uplifting and Accepting My Anxiety Meditation / Meditation for Anxiety (condition named).
Free Guide to Meditation (lists physiological benefits such as heart rate and digestion; borderline, left out).
Hatta Mountain Retreat (30 Oct to 1 Nov 2026): already passed. Resource Retreat Greece (Aug 2026): passed.
How to Host Your Own Wellness Retreat masterclass ($143): business skills, not spiritual teaching. 3-Day Online Wellness Reset: not opened. Free worksheets: dated (2022/2023) or not teaching.
YouTube: 'Welcoming 2021' manifestation meditation (dated), the Names vigil videos, talks noted in flags.
